name: Kershaw
gaps: Parcels are SC RFA Kershaw_Parcels (county-specific layer w/ CAMA, boundary program map) (https://services9.arcgis.com/RvqSyw3diI7dTKo5/arcgis/rest/services/Fairfield_Kershaw_Richland_Map_WFL1/FeatureServer/7). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Owner, market/assessed/taxable values, and sale history are not present in the public Parcels_view REST layer; use qPublic / county deed search for PA verification.
No stable parcel-specific qPublic deep-link pattern verified; official search URL supports parcelId/TMS lookup.
Camden is within Kershaw County and is covered by the countywide sources above; no separate Camden county card is needed.
Reject SCDOT SC_Parcels token-walled services as a primary source; KershawGIS Parcels_view is public and preferred.
